textSegments: Complies with ATX 12V V2.4 & EPS 12V V2.92
True Power, You Can Count On
With 0.9 Active Power Factor Correction, the NEW HEXA+ series comes across with guarantee wattage of continuous power, delivers full power to your PC system.
An advanced thermal control fan makes optimal cooling and reduces noise under maximum operation.
Selected bulk capacitor provides superior reliability under intense current operation environment.
High-quality copper heat sink to provide excellent cooling performance, it prolong PSU lifespan and reinforce reliability.
Custom fuse keeps PSU in safe when product is in error and ensure users PC to be secured under unsafe environment.
The NEW HEXA+ series follows global safety standard, its grounded design can enhance current stability and ensure safety under maximum operation.
